scope: posthoc component CUDA-event timing of fixed 32 observed pilot plus 96 added DEV images
limitations: Each image contributes its median of five calls; distributions report across-image medians and range.
K512 fails exact order on one pilot image; its fused and graph timings were not taken; candidate and paired summaries use 127/128, with possible selection bias.
96-image expansion was decided after seeing 32-image pilot; full 128 is not an independent confirmation.
Fused and graph share the same fused selector kernel; setup is separate and is not end-to-end TTFT.
During the measurement window lightweight code editing and background activity occurred with no per-sample interference windows recorded; their impact is unknown.
PyTorch allocated/reserved setup delta is not device-wide peak memory.
